submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce one opaque full-bleed native1254-square game-map detail for r09_c09/r02_c03. Image1 gives exact framing, scale and existing object footprints. The TOP115 rows and RIGHTMOST115 columns are native neighbor references: preserve existing contours, grooves, materials and shadow endpoints at their exact coordinates; north wins the shared top-right corner. Rows115..229 and columns1024..1138 contain guide-only soft transitions into regional context. Rebuild those into continuous painting; never copy guide bounds as walls, steps, dark bars, abrupt texture changes or truncated grooves. Reconstruct the soft interior as crisp native detail. Image2 is the user-approved primary painting/material style: bright, clean, rounded, full-bodied Daoist chibi fantasy with smooth readable bevels and restrained low-contrast surfaces. Copy no UI, text, symbols, floral ornaments, characters, lighting or objects from Image2. Keep ONLY objects and materials already present in Image1; no additions, recropping, repositioning, rotation or enlargement. Quiet ivory stone: no grit, cracks, veins, stains, bright scored scratches, harsh brush patches, blur or sharpening halos. Rounded clean existing leaves. No new buildings, stairs, medallions, frames, labels or watermark. Return only this single native detail image.
Actual crop inventory: quiet warm ivory stone plaza occupies most of this square. Along the top only, preserve the pre-existing cropped rounded green shrub, curved ivory planter wall, and pale square stone post with rounded bevels and its existing soft ground shadow. Keep the single long sloping paving seam beneath the planter and its existing short diagonal connector, exactly matching the input positions and widths. No other groove exists in the open lower plaza: do not add joints, scratches, lamps, water, bridge or plants. Keep the large stone plane quiet and avoid high-contrast rectangular brush patches. Do not reproduce the subtle straight guide transition at the top/right as an object or artificial stripe.
